content: अध्यूढ {%a.%} [अधि उपरि ऊढः] .²1 Raised, exalted, elevated, hanging over. एतस्यामृच्यध्यूढँ साम तस्मादृच्यध्यूढँ साम गीयते <ls>Ch. Up. 1. 6. 1</ls>. .²2 Abundant, increased, copious. .²3 Rich, affluent. .{@-ढः@} .²1 Śiva. .²2 The son of a woman pregnant before marriage; अध्यूढश्च तथाऽपरः <ls>Mb. 13. 49. 4</ls>. .{@-ढा@} A wife whose husband has married another wife and thus superseded her (= अधिविन्ना <ab>q. v.</ab>). अध्यूढायाश्च यद् दुःखं साक्षिभिर्विहितस्य च <ls>Mb. 2. 68. 83</ls>.
